purpose: City-specific discovery of official cadastral parcel sources for Kabongo, Democratic Republic of the Congo; claims are limited to observed first-party evidence.
name: Kabongo

queries.query: Kabongo Democratic Republic of the Congo official cadastral parcel GIS map land registry
queries.result: Search identified the official DRC Ministry of Land Affairs site, its land/cadastral jurisdiction directory, the official public-service register-consultation procedure, and the BIC cadastral viewer. No public Kabongo parcel geometry or city-specific service endpoint was identified.

queries.query: Kabongo RDC cadastre parcelles carte SIG circonscription foncière Haut-Lomami
queries.result: Search identified the same first-party Ministry directory and formal consultation procedure, plus an official CAID administrative map for the Kabongo territory. These are jurisdiction/administrative or procedure sources, not an open parcel ID-plus-geometry service. No Kabongo parcel geometry was established.

officialSources.observation: Current official Ministry of Land Affairs jurisdiction directory was fetched anonymously. The rendered page identifies 143 land/cadastral jurisdictions across 26 provinces, but the observed HTML did not expose a Kabongo-specific parcel layer, schema, CRS, or geometry response. It is national custodian/jurisdiction evidence only.

Official DRC public-service catalogue describes formal consultation of cadastral and land registers through the competent Conservateur des Titres Immobiliers or Chef de Division du Cadastre. It requires a formal request and is not an open parcel-geometry API.

First-party Bureau d'Informations Cadastrales viewer was fetched and its current JavaScript/configuration inspected. The public page states parcel service availability for Nord-Kivu and Sud-Kivu; no Haut-Lomami/Kabongo coverage or safe anonymous parcel response was established.

Official CAID administrative map for the Kabongo territory, WGS 84, was found. It shows administrative geography and explicitly cites the Référentiel Géographique Commun; it is not cadastral parcel data.

requests.outcome: Anonymous HTML returned successfully. No parcel IDs, geometry, schema, CRS, or map/API endpoint was returned in the inspected response; no Kabongo-specific service was evidenced.

requests.method: GET official Ministry homepage and current JavaScript/configuration
requests.outcome: Anonymous HTML returned successfully. The site advertises cadastral documents, jurisdictions, and formal services, but no public parcel ID-plus-geometry service was exposed.
Procedure page returned successfully. It documents paid/formal register consultation through competent land-affairs offices; no open geometry response or service schema was exposed.

requests.method: GET public cadastral viewer plus current JavaScript/configuration inspection
requests.outcome: Viewer shell returned successfully. The visible service statement limits currently available parcel service to Nord-Kivu and Sud-Kivu. No Kabongo/Haut-Lomami parcel response was requested or retained; no login, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or private credential was used.
Administrative territory map downloaded for qualification evidence. It contains administrative/place/road context, not parcel IDs or parcel polygons, so no GeoJSON sample was retained.

registryBasis: No Kabongo-local registry/cadastre map, public parcel service, or local custodian was actually evidenced. National Ministry and formal public-service procedure pages are general custodial/procedural evidence only.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: DRC national land-affairs ministry and public-service procedure pages were identified; CAID provides administrative Kabongo map context.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: No Kabongo or Haut-Lomami open parcel ID-plus-geometry response, schema, CRS, or local registry map was verified.

remainingUncertainty: A local Haut-Lomami/Kabongo office workflow, non-indexed viewer route, or future BIC expansion may provide parcel geometry. The exact WUP point was preserved and not shifted. No exact-point or map-extent miss was used as evidence of citywide absence. No credentials, private tokens, unsafe fields, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or TLS verification disablement was used.
